matching: Exact original URL string; keep scheme, host, path, query, trailing slash. Aliases are separate candidate relations, never propagated Google status.
conflicts: Append observations; preserve old evidence and dates. New file date alone does not prove newer URL status. Flag contradictory same-scope observations.
missing_rows: unknown; absence from examples or truncated query table is not zero, indexed, or problem-free
query_binding: Only a verified exact-page filter binds its queries to that page; marginal country/device tables do not produce a query-country-device join. Missing filter metadata requires owner confirmation.
comparability: Keep country/device/date/search-type cohorts separate; retain clicks and impressions, compute CTR only for a matching denominator; do not average position or CTR across incompatible/overlapping cohorts.
cannibalization: Require query-to-multiple-current-canonical-landing evidence in comparable cohorts and evidence of competing intent or instability. Shared words, canonical aliases and two aggregate page rows are not proof.
indexed_evidence: Official URL inspection or indexed examples with source/date; impressions establish historic visibility, not current index state.
period_provenance: Absolute dates are first/last daily Gráfico rows (92 observations), not literal absolute Filtros metadata. Filtros says Últimos 3 meses. Confirm exact selected range before before/after or segmented comparison.
